# fw convert

> Reference of the fw convert command: Convert a file into other files: video to SVG frames, Markdown, HTML, JSX and GPUI source (runs fw-video). Usage, aliases…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/convert/

Convert a file into other files: video to SVG frames, Markdown, HTML, JSX and GPUI source (runs fw-video)

## Usage

```bash
fw convert <input> <out-dir> [--to svg,md,html,jsx,gpui] [--fps N] [--width N]
```

## Aliases

`fw cv` runs `fw convert`.

## Flags

The help text names these flags: `--to`, `--fps`, `--width`.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
